clients.title: Use with other clients
clients.intro: How to test against this server from other speed test clients, and what BitGauge is.
clients.v03Body: The LibreSpeed, OpenSpeedTest and networkQuality layers are not part of this version, so there are no snippets yet.

about.unreachable: BitGauge could not reach the server at {host}, so its version and name are unknown until it answers.

methodology.title: How it measures
methodology.summary: Download and upload run over one or more HTTP streams; the warm-up is discarded before the rate is computed. Idle latency and jitter are measured over WebSocket (HTTP if unavailable). Each result also reports the data used and the test duration.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: No accounts, no tracking, no ads. The server keeps no results — history lives only in your browser.
